scientific_integrity: The known minimum-palette theorem and foundational definitions are credited; the bijection, counts, and orbit types are proved here from the stated definitions.
scientific_limitations: Proves classification only for labelled complete bipartite graphs with one part of size two and the other of size at least three.
Counts minimum-palette named colourings; quotient equivalence allows vertex and palette relabelling.
Does not classify higher-palette colourings or general complete bipartite graphs.
Historical priority remains provisional; the founding 2024 full text was unavailable.
Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Derangement rigidity of optimal rich-neighbor colourings of \(K_{2,n}\)
